parts.text:
Produce a paired_revision implementing the full live-ground-truth architecture in the current Agents.md, send-to-gemini.js, and shared Supervisor config. Return complete replacement contents for all three files; do not return patches. Preserve all existing valid state-machine behavior, Steps 0-4, Step 3 TSR semantics, persistence, roles, and supervisory transitions unless a change is required for this implementation.

Implementation requirements:
1. Add a tamper-evident per-run observation ledger at runs/<run_nonce>/observations.jsonl. Each runtime-generated observation must have sequence, runtime-generated observation_id/obs_id, timestamp, operation, target/locator, current version/ref, SHA-256 content hash, bounded excerpt where appropriate, result status, parent hash, and record hash. Use an append-only SHA-256 hash chain and verify the chain before accepting evidence.
2. Add an Evidence Gateway for send-to-gemini.js internal material reads/checks (filesystem, git, relevant environment/network observations). Route existing ground-truth reads through it so runtime observations are mechanically logged. Do not falsely claim this can intercept ChatGPT's connected GitHub-tool reads: those occur outside the Node process.
3. Therefore also implement a controller evidence request/receipt mechanism in send-to-gemini.js and the contract/config surface. A controller must be able to submit a repository-backed observation request that the Node runtime can execute against live state and persist as an authenticated observation receipt containing an obs_id. Design this so a later workflow integration can trigger the observation mode by commit/request before the final execution return is submitted. Include a CLI or explicit runtime mode suitable for that workflow. The receipt must be generated by runtime code, not by the model.
4. Bind execution/completion evidence to runtime-generated obs_ids. Model-authored prose, locators, or snippets alone are never authoritative. For Step 4 completed_actions, completion evidence must cite a valid observation_id plus locator/hash fields sufficient for deterministic binding. Reject fabricated, stale, wrong-run, wrong-step, wrong-target, tampered, or non-VERIFIED observations. Existing passive path/SHA verification may remain as supplementary checking but may not substitute for required bound evidence when the claim is execution/completion dependent.
5. Add deterministic randomized adversarial verification support: derive a reproducible seed from live run facts such as run_nonce, step, attempt and git HEAD; generate at least 16 live-state probe types/categories after the controller submission is fixed; compute answers mechanically from live state; keep oracles unavailable to the model until evaluation; persist seed/questions/oracles/results after evaluation for audit. Preserve separation between this audit layer and the primary obs_id proof mechanism.
6. FINAL GATE MUST BE SIMPLE CODE, NOT MODEL JUDGMENT: real PASS equals (ground-truth PASS AND Gemini PASS). Implement the equivalent of: const realPass = groundTruth.aggregate_status === 'PASS' && geminiGate.gate_result === 'PASS'; const gateResult = realPass ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'; The model cannot override, reinterpret, waive, or score this conjunction. Every other combination is FAIL.
7. Prefer a hybrid provenance model: immediate hash-chained observation journaling plus normal/batched Git checkpoint anchoring. Do NOT create a Git commit for every read. The actual workflow checkpoint changes will be handled in a later integration pass, but source/config/Agents must expose the required paths/modes/fields cleanly.
8. Add deterministic validation/repair behavior for malformed observation references and ledger tamper. A tampered chain must be blocking. Missing/unbound execution evidence must be blocking when evidence is required.
9. Keep the trusted computing base minimal. Do not claim Object.freeze(fs) or wrappers make external ChatGPT tool calls observable. State the real boundary in Agents.md.
10. revised_source_config must add only the configuration needed to support the implemented observation ledger/request modes while preserving existing config keys and path semantics.

Return response_type paired_revision with complete revised_agents_md, complete revised_program, and complete revised_source_config.
